duas.title: Dua for Anxiety and Depression
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، الْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ
duas.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahul-'Adheemul-Haleem, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-'ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem
duas.translation:
There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

The Prophet (ﷺ) used to invoke Allah at the time of distress, saying, (the dua is mentioned above). [1] Ali (RA) said, The Messenger of Allah taught me this above mentioned dua in the state of anxiety and distress. [2]
duas.reference: [1] Bukhari: 6346 [2] Sahih Ibn Hibban 3/147, Musnad Ahmad 194

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَهْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say at a time of distress, "La ilaha illal-lahu Rabbul-l-'arsh il-'azim, La ilaha illallahu Rabbu-s-samawati wa Rabbu-l-ard, Rabbu-l-'arsh-il-Karim." Sahih al-Bukhari 6346 [[1] Bukhari 6346 [2] Sahih Ibn Hibban 3/147, Musnad Ahmad 194]

duas.arabic: اَللَّهُ اَللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا

Narrated Asma' daughter of Umays (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: May I not teach you phrases which you utter in distress? These are: (The dua is mentioned avobe)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ، قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكِ كَلِمَاتٍ تَقُولِينَهُنَّ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ أَوْ فِي الْكَرْبِ اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ هَذَا هِلاَلٌ مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Asma' daughter of Umays: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: May I not teach you phrases which you utter in distress? (These are:) "Allah , Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything as partner with Him." Abu Dawud said: The narrator Hilal is a client of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-Aziz. The name of Ja'far, a narrator, is 'Abd Allah b. Ja'far. [Abu Dawud : 1525]

duas.title: Dua for Distress
duas.introduction: Narrated Abdullah Ibn Masood (RA): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said, "If a servant is faced with any anxiety or distress, then say:
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'abduka, wabnu 'abdika, wabnu 'amatika, naasiyatee biyadika, maadhin fiyya hukmuka, 'adlun fiyya qadhaa'uka, 'as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, 'aw 'anzaltahu fee kitaabika, 'aw 'allamtahu 'ahadan min khalqika, 'awista'tharta bihi fee 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indaka, 'an taj'alal-Qur'aana rabee'a qalbee, wa noora sadree, wa jalaa'a huznee, wa thahaaba hammee
duas.translation:
O Allah, I am Your slave and the son of Your male slave and the son of your female slave. My forehead is in Your Hand (i.e. you have control over me). Your Judgment upon me is assured and Your Decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every Name that You have named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught any one of Your creation or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You, to make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness and the reliever of my distress.

Allah will surely remove his worries and troubles and replace them with joy. ”It was asked, O Messenger of Allah! Shall we not learn it? ' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, “Of course! Anyone who hears this should memorize it.”

duas.title: Duas for Depression
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'A'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani, wal'ajzi wal-kasali, wal-bukhli wal-jubni, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i.e. others).

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ الْتَمِسْ غُلاَمًا مِنْ غِلْمَانِكُمْ يَخْدُمُنِي حَتَّى أَخْرُجَ إِلَى خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ بِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ مُرْدِفِي، وَأَنَا غُلاَمٌ رَاهَقْتُ الْحُلُمَ، فَكُنْتُ أَخْدُمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَزَلَ، فَكُنْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ كَثِيرًا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَدِمْنَا خَيْبَرَ، فَلَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْحِصْنَ ذُكِرَ لَهُ جَمَالُ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ حُيَىِّ بْنِ أَخْطَبَ، وَقَدْ قُتِلَ زَوْجُهَا وَكَانَتْ عَرُوسًا، فَاصْطَفَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِنَفْسِهِ، فَخَرَجَ بِهَا حَتَّى بَلَغْنَا سَدَّ الصَّهْبَاءِ حَلَّتْ، فَبَنَى بِهَا، ثُمَّ صَنَعَ حَيْسًا فِي نِطَعٍ صَغِيرٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ آذِنْ مَنْ حَوْلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ وَلِيمَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى صَفِيَّةَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَوِّي لَهَا وَرَاءَهُ بِعَبَاءَةٍ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ عِنْدَ بَعِيرِهِ فَيَضَعُ رُكْبَتَهُ، فَتَضَعُ صَفِيَّةُ رِجْلَهَا عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ حَتَّى تَرْكَبَ، فَسِرْنَا حَتَّى إِذَا أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ نَظَرَ إِلَى أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا بِمِثْلِ مَا حَرَّمَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مَكَّةَ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مُدِّهِمْ وَصَاعِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha, "Choose one of your boy servants to serve me in my expedition to Khaibar." So, Abu Talha took me letting me ride behind him while I was a boy nearing the age of puberty. I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he stopped to rest. I heard him saying repeatedly, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from distress and sorrow, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being heavily in debt and from being overcome by men." Then we reached Khaibar; and when Allah enabled him to conquer the Fort (of Khaibar), the beauty of Safiya bint Huyai bin Akhtab was described to him. Her husband had been killed while she was a bride. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) selected her for himself and took her along with him till we reached a place called Sa`d-AsSahba,' where her menses were over and he took her for his wife. Haris (a kind of dish) was served on a small leather sheet. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to call those who were around me. So, that was the marriage banquet of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Safiya. Then we left for Medina. I saw Allah's Apostle folding a cloak round the hump of the camel so as to make a wide space for Safiya (to sit on behind him) He sat beside his camel letting his knees for Safiya to put her feet on so as to mount the camel. Then, we proceeded till we approached Medina; he looked at Uhud (mountain) and said, "This is a mountain which loves us and is loved by us." Then he looked at Medina and said, "O Allah! I make the area between its (i.e. Medina's) two mountains a sanctuary as Abraham made Mecca a sanctuary. O Allah! Bless them (i.e. the people of Medina) in their Mudd and Sa (i.e. measures). [Bukhari :2893]

duas.title: Dua Anxiety Depression
duas.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, “The supplication of the anxious person is -
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma rahmataka 'arjoo falaa takilnee 'ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayen, wa 'aslih lee sha'nee kullahu, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta
duas.translation:
O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.

Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this supplication increasingly.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْجَلِيلِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لأَبِيهِ يَا أَبَةِ إِنِّي أَسْمَعُكَ تَدْعُو كُلَّ غَدَاةٍ اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ تُعِيدُهَا ثَلاَثًا حِينَ تُصْبِحُ وَثَلاَثًا حِينَ تُمْسِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُو بِهِنَّ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْتَنَّ بِسُنَّتِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبَّاسٌ فِيهِ وَتَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ تُعِيدُهَا ثَلاَثًا حِينَ تُصْبِحُ وَثَلاَثًا حِينَ تُمْسِي فَتَدْعُو بِهِنَّ فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْتَنَّ بِسُنَّتِهِ قَالَ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعَوَاتُ الْمَكْرُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ وَبَعْضُهُمْ يَزِيدُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Narrated AbuBakrah: AbdurRahman ibn AbuBakrah said that he told his father: O my father! I hear you supplicating every morning: "O Allah! Grant me health in my body. O Allah! Grant me good hearing. O Allah! Grant me good eyesight. There is no god but Thou." You repeat them three times in the morning and three times in the evening. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) using these words as a supplication and I like to follow his practice. The transmitter, Abbas, said in this version: And you say: "O Allah! I seek refuge in Thee from infidelity and poverty. O Allah! I seek refuge in Thee from punishment in the grave. There is no god but Thee". You repeat them three times in the morning and three times in the evening, and use them as a supplication. I like to follow his practice. He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The supplications to be used by one who is distressed are: "O Allah! Thy mercy is what I hope for. Do not abandon me to myself for an instant, but put all my affairs in good order for me. There is no god but Thou." Some transmitters added more than others. [Hasan (Albani) Abu Dawud: 5090]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua of Death Agony from Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
benefits.description: This dua of death reminds every Muslim to keep faith strong and remember Allah’s mercy, especially when facing the pain and fear of sakaratul maut in the last moments of life.
points: Allah gives peace to the heart of a Muslim who says this dua of death.
Saying la ilaha ilallah in sakaratul maut helps keep Iman strong till the end.
This Islamic prayer for death brings hope and eases the pain of maut for believers.
The remembrance of Allah in this dua for death brings Barakah in the last breath.
Kalima in this dua helps a Muslim leave the world with Allah’s name on the tongue.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua Anxiety Depression
when_to_recite.description: This dua anxiety depression is a strong masnoon dua for asking Allah’s mercy, Barakah, and help when your heart feels heavy, your mind is full, or you need peace and strength in your Amal.
points: After feeling lost in overthinking, use the dua anxiety depression for calm and hope.
When stress or sadness comes, turn to la ilaha illa anta for peace of mind and Iman.
Before making big choices, recite this dua for ease in all matters and Allah’s help.
In times of weakness or fear, remember this dua for strength and patience in Amal.
Before going to bed with worries, make the dua for anxiety and depression for Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua Anxiety Depression
how_to_perform.description: This dua anxiety depression is a strong Muslim prayer for anyone feeling sadness, stress, or worry. It brings peace of mind and helps you ask Allah for help in all matters, big or small, every day.
steps: Start by sitting in a quiet place and softly recite this dua for anxiety and depression.
After your fard salah, raise your hands and say this dua for peace of mind with hope.
When overthinking or sadness comes, use this dua for stress and anxiety to calm your heart.
If you face problems or need strength, repeat la ilaha illa anta as a zikr allah for help.
Before going to bed, read this dua for everything to ask Allah to fix all your affairs.

duas.title: Dua of Depression
duas.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Yunus) when he supplicated, while in the belly of the whale was:
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.translation:
There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.

So indeed, no Muslim man supplicates with it for anything, ever, except Allah responds to him. [1]

benefits.title: Benefits of Remembrance of Allah (La ilaha illallah Dhikr)
benefits.description: This remembrance of Allah fills the heart with peace and brings Barakah in daily life, making every Muslim feel close to Allah with every word of dhikr and tasbih on the tongue.
points: Allahu Akbar in this dhikr brings calm and keeps the heart away from waswasah.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu gives strong Iman and Amal in life.
Zikrullah with this best dhikr wipes away sins and brings Allah’s mercy closer.
Tasbih and takbeer in this remembrance of Allah brings Barakah in every Amal.
Saying la ilaha ilallah daily helps a Muslim get reward and peace from Allah.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua of Depression
when_to_recite.description: This dua of depression, la ilaha illa anta subhanaka, is a strong ayat e karima for asking Allah’s forgiveness, Barakah, and help when you feel lost, need mercy, or want to fix your Amal and Iman.
points: After making a mistake, use the dua of depression for forgiveness and Allah’s mercy.
When facing big problems, recite la ilaha illa anta subhanaka for relief and Barakah.
In times of stress and anxiety, remember this dua for distress and peace in your heart.
Before starting your day, make dua e yunus for protection from enemies and hardship.
When feeling weak in Iman, turn to this most powerful dua for strength and repentance.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of Depression
how_to_perform.description: This dua of depression, known as the dua of Yunus, is a powerful quranic dua for anyone feeling sadness, stress, or needing forgiveness. It brings hope and helps you seek Allah’s mercy in times of hardship and problems.
steps: Begin by making fresh wudu and recite la ilaha illa anta subhanaka with full Iman.
When you feel heavy with problems, say this dua for stress and anxiety from your heart.
During namaz sujood, whisper this dua of depression to ask Allah for forgiveness.
If you face enemies or fear, repeat ayat e karima as a Muslim prayer for protection.
While walking alone or feeling lost, use this dua for all problems to find Barakah.

duas.title: Dua for Seeing Others in Hardship
duas.introduction: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A person who sees a person in danger, then says:
duas.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee 'aafaanee mimmab-talaaka bihi wa fadhdhalanee 'alaa katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdheela
duas.translation:
Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.

That danger will not touch him.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ السِّمْنَانِيُّ، وَغَيْرُ، وَاحِدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْعُمَرِيُّ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ رَأَى مُبْتَلًى فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً لَمْ يُصِبْهُ ذَلِكَ الْبَلاَءُ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Abu Hurairah narrated that: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever sees an afflicted person then says: ‘All praise is due to Allah who saved me from that which He has afflicted you with, and blessed me greatly over many of those whom He has created, (Al-ḥamdulillāhi alladhī `āfānī mimmabtalāka bihī wa faḍḍalanī `alā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīla)’ he shall not be struck by that affliction.” [Sahih (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3432]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Patience in Hard Times
benefits.description: This dua for patience helps Muslims find hope and Sabr in every musibah, letting the heart trust Allah’s plan and wait for better days with faith and calmness.
points: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un brings Sabr and peace in times of sadness.
Allahumma ajurni fi musibati gives reward and Barakah for every hard time faced.
This dua for patience in Islam helps a Muslim stay strong when calamity comes.
Saying this dua for hard times lets Allah replace pain with something better.
Innalillahiwainnailaihirojiun gives comfort and hope when someone feels lost.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua for Hardship
when_to_recite.description: This dua for hardship is a masnoon dua to thank Allah for His Barakah, protection, and health when you see others in pain, reminding you to say Alhamdulillah and show shukar in your daily Amal.
points: After seeing someone in sickness, quietly recite the dua for health and protection.
When you notice others facing hardship, thank Allah with this dua for blessings.
On visiting a sick person, use this dua for protection from the same hardship.
While hearing about someone’s difficult times, remember to say alhamdulillah for everything.
After witnessing any musibat, make this prayer of gratitude for Allah’s mercy and ease.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Hardship
how_to_perform.description: This dua for hardship is a Muslim prayer of gratitude when you see others in trouble. It reminds you to thank Allah for His blessings, health, and protection, and to show shukar alhamdulillah in every moment.
steps: When you see someone in pain, quietly say alhamdulillah for everything Allah gave.
After hearing about sickness, recite this dua for health and protection from hardship.
If you feel blessed, use this dua for blessings to thank Allah for His mercy and ease.
During difficult times, remember this dua for ease and praise be to God for your safety.
While visiting someone unwell, softly read this prayer of gratitude for your own Barakah.

duas.title: Dua When Depressed (Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum Bi Rahmatika Astagheeth)
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيْثُ
duas.translation:
O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance.

Whenever a matter would distress him, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say (above dua)

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْمُكْتِبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَدْرٍ، شُجَاعُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ عَنِ الرُّحَيْلِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ، أَخِي زُهَيْرِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَرَبَهُ أَمْرٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَبِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلِظُّوا بِيَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ مِنْ غَيْرِ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏
hadith.translation: Anas bin Malik said: “Whenever a matter would distress him, the Prophet (ﷺ) would say: ‘O Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief (Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, bi-raḥmatika astaghīth).’” And with this chain, that he said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘Be constant with: “O Possessor of Majesty and Honor (Yā Dhal-Jalāli wal-Ikrām).’” [Hasan (Albani). Tirmidhi: 3524]

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Deceased and Sick Person (Masnoon Dua)
benefits.description: This dua for deceased brings hope and maghfirat for both the sick and the dead, letting Muslims ask Allah for forgiveness and a better future with every heartfelt word.
points: Allahummaghfirli in this dua for deceased brings maghfirat for both persons.
Asking Allah in this masnoon dua gives peace to the heart after someone’s death.
This dua for the dead helps a Muslim wish for Jannah and forgiveness in Islam.
Dua for the sick and dead person brings Barakah and hope for a better tomorrow.
Prayer for the dead Islam gives comfort and Amal to those left behind.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua When Depressed
when_to_recite.description: This dua when depressed, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, is a simple way to call on Allah’s mercy and help, bringing Barakah and calm to the heart when stress, sadness, or worry makes life feel heavy.
points: After every namaz, repeat ya hayyu ya qayyum birahmatika astaghees for peace.
In moments of deep sadness, turn to this dua for anxiety and depression for relief.
Before going to bed, recite ya hayyu ya qayyum ka wazifa to ease your heart and mind.
When stress or worry comes, use this dua for stress and anxiety to seek Allah’s help.
During quiet zikr allah, remember ya hayyu ya qayyum meaning and ask for Barakah.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua When Depressed
how_to_perform.description: This dua when depressed, ya hayyu ya qayyum, is a short but strong Muslim prayer for anyone feeling low or needing Allah’s help. It brings hope and is easy to say in any moment of sadness or stress.
steps: After every namaz, quietly recite ya hayyu ya qayyum birahmatika astaghees for peace.
When you feel lost or heavy, say this dua for anxiety and depression with full trust in Allah.
In times of stress, repeat ya hayyu ya qayyum as a zikr allah to ask for help and Barakah.
Before going to bed, softly read this dua asking Allah for help to calm your heart and mind.
While alone or worried, use this Muslim prayer to remember Allah’s mercy and find ease.

duas.title: Dua to be Recited in Danger (inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji un)
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ، اَللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ أَحْتَسِبُ مُصِيْبَتِيْ فَأْجُرْنِيْ فِيْهَا وَأَبْدِلْنِيْ مِنْهَا خَيْرًا.
duas.transliteration: Inna lillaahi wa inna ilayhi raaji`un, Allaahumma `indaka ahtasibu musibati fa’jurni fihaa wa abdilni minhaa khair.
duas.translation: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, I seek reward with You for my affliction, so reward me for it, and replace it for me with something better.

hadith.title: Hadith about the Dua
hadith.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَصَابَ أَحَدَكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ فَلْيَقُلْ ‏: ‏ ‏
hadith.translation: (‏ إنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ ‏)‏ اللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ احْتَسَبْتُ مُصِيبَتِي فَأْجُرْنِي فِيهَا وَأَبْدِلْنِي مِنْهَا خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا احْتُضِرَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ اخْلُفْ فِي أَهْلِي خَيْرًا مِنِّي فَلَمَّا قُبِضَ قَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ ‏: ‏ ‏(‏ إنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ ‏)‏ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ احْتَسَبْتُ مُصِيبَتِي فَأْجُرْنِي فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏ وَرُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ مِنْ غَيْرِ هَذَا الْوَجْهِ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ اسْمُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَسَدِ ‏.‏ Umar bin Abu Salamah narrated from his mother, Umm Salamah, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When a calamity strikes one of you, then let him say: ‘Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, I seek reward with You for my affliction, so reward me for it, and replace it for me with something better (Innā lillāhi wa innā ilaihi rāji`ūn, Allāhumma `indaka aḥtasibu muṣībatī fa’jurnī fīhā wa abdilnī minhā khair).’” When the time of death was near Abu Salamah, he said: ‘O Allah, replace me for my wife, with better than me.” So when he died, Umm Salamah said: “Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. I seek reward with Allah for my affliction, so reward me for it.” Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3511 [Sahih (Albani). Tirmizi: 3511]

duas.title: Dua for the return of lost objects
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَادَّ الضَّالَّةِ وَهَادِيَ الضَّلَالَةِ أَنْتَ تَهْدِيْ مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، اُرْدُدْ عَلَيَّ ضَالَّتِيْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ عَطَائِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma raaddad daallati wa haadiyad dalaalati anta tahdi minad dalaalah, urdud alayya daallati biqudratika wa sultaanika fainnahaa min ataaika wa fadlik.
duas.translation: O Allah, the Returner of lost things, the Guide to the lost, You are the Guide to the lost. You, in your power and strength, give me back what I lost. Because, this object is given by you and I got it by your grace.

duas.title: Dua for Stress and Anxiety
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahul halimul karim, subhaanallaahi rabbis samawaatis sab’i wa rabbil ‘arshil ‘azim, alhamdu lillaahi rabbil ‘aalamin.
duas.translation: There is no true God but Allah the Most Patient, the Most Honorable. I am proclaiming the holiness of the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the glorious throne. All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
